During the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]], an [[Disciples of Ragnos]] [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] '''attacked''' a [[Crashed merchant vessel|merchant ship]] near [[Blenjeel]], forcing it to crash-land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Jedi trainee [[Jaden Korr]] later [[Mission to Blenjeel|arrived]] to find any survivors.
